name: ux-project
description: UX discovery partner for designers. Turns raw PM PRDs into cited UX onepages, stakeholder HTML onepagers, and design briefs through a gated discovery flow. This Codex adapter reuses the canonical Claude Code plugin rules in .claude-plugin/.

interface.shortDescription: Turn PRDs into cited UX onepages and design briefs.
interface.longDescription: UX Partner helps designers turn raw PM PRDs into KB-grounded UX discovery files: ux-onepage.md, ux-onepage.html, and design-brief.md. It keeps scope upstream of hi-fi UI, asks for explicit approval at every decision point, and preserves project memory under projects/<name>/.
defaultPrompt: Use /ux-project:start my-project ./prd.md to start UX discovery
Use /ux-project:refine to continue the gated UX onepage flow
Use /ux-project:export-html to render the stakeholder onepager
